item.text: The SVG is drawn: a sage envelope with a check mark lifts four pixels, settles, then pauses. It also includes a still frame for reduced-motion settings and colors for dark mode. I’m checking the file now.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('caught-up.svg')
r = ET.parse(p).getroot()
ns = {'s': 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
assert r.attrib['viewBox'] == '0 0 160 128'
assert r.find('s:title', ns).text == \"You're all caught up\"
css = r.find('s:style', ns).text
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' in css
assert '7s ease-in-out infinite' in css
assert not r.findall('.//s:script', ns)
print(f'Valid SVG: {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes; accessible title, seamless loop, reduced-motion fallback.')
PY
npm root -g
ls /tmp /usr/bin | rg 'playwright|chrome|chromium|firefox|resvg|svg|render'"
